A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, we have established the existence and uniqueness theorems of solutions to the above equations with prescribed generalized symmetric behavior at infinity, and the uniqueness theorem is new even in the case of the Dirichlet problem.

, we have extended the previous results of the exterior Dirchlet problem for the Hessian equation, Hessian quotient equation and the special Lagragian equation, and have obtained the existence and uniqueness of solutions of exterior Dirichlet problems for a more general class of fully nonlinear equations.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the existence and uniqueness of solutions for the exterior Dirichet problem of fully nonlinear equations can be obtained by using the maximum principle and the Perron method.

the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the exterior Dirichet problem for these equations can be established by using the maximum principle for fully nonlinear elliptic equation and the method of continuity, which is a different approach compared with the previous results.

the existence and uniqueness of the solutions of the exterior Hessian equation, the exterior Hessian quotient equation, the exterior special Lagrangian equation, etc, can be obtained from our general existence and uniqueness theorem, which is a unified result for these equations.
